description: Aste Stradali is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by comunecervia.it. Vista degli archi stradali attivi gestiti dalla toponomastica mediante specifico applicativo nell'ambito del progetto ACI. I campi di riferimento sono i seguenti: IDSTD: ID stadio dell'arcoCODVIA: Codice via cui l'arco appartieneNOMEVIA: Denominazione della viaDATAINIZIO: Data di inizio validità dell'arco. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include Reti di trasporto. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2024-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://w3id.org/italia/controlled-vocabulary/licences/A21_CCBY40). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
